plan.thesis: Adopt existing PB-001 ballast holding of 142 EFA (reconciled avg cost 100.495) under explicit protection: retain developed-ex-US equity diversification as ballast with daily-close invalidation at 100.00. This thesis is protective retention under a defined stop, NOT a claim EFA will rise; weakness (three consecutive down sessions into 100.26 close, intraday 99.96 low on Nov-18, yen at ~159.94/USD) is acknowledged in the review. Take-profit 105.80 is the 20-completed-session structural high (2026-11-04 bar) stated as a profit-taking guard, NOT a price forecast; PB-001 strategy exits occur by rebalance.
invalidation_rules: (i) A completed daily close below 100.00 (stop basis daily_close) latches the stop_loss exit; intraday trades below the level alone do not trigger it.
(ii) Rotation momentum <= 0 or regime risk_off triggers a trim per PB-001, evaluated at rebalance only; this is NOT automatic liquidation.
(iii) A material thesis-breaking event acknowledged by a fresh timestamped review (verdict invalidated with cited condition-specific evidence) invalidates the plan.
(iv) No broker-native stop exists: protection is a synthetic hourly monitor; gaps, halts, delayed runs and limit non-fills can exceed the planned loss.

limitations: Gaps, stale feeds, hourly latency and non-fills can exceed planned loss.
Daily-close triggers execute no earlier than the next permitted session.
Full-position exits only; no shorting, scaling or automatic re-entry.
Unknown/cancelled/rejected orders require reconciliation and operator review.
